QuestInfo.name: Eurenth's Favorites 3
QuestInfo.0: #bTonero#k has one last ace up his sleeve.
QuestInfo.2: Eurenth finally agreed to talk after you gave him the hand-stamped Angelic Buster Figurine.

0.msg: #b(You tell him that Eurenth simply ate the Dinodon Ribs himself and didn't say you a thing.)#k\r\n

1.msg: I see that we must turn now to our last resort. Our final gambit... not even the miserly Eurenth can resist this lure!\r\n

2.msg: And we didn't start with this... why?\r\n

3.msg: The fault is mine, as I underestimated the man's obstinance. Now, behold, the #i4036158:# #b#t4036158:##k! Obtaining this was no easy feat. Take it, now, to #bEurenth#k.\r\n

0.msg: This figurine has been hand-stamped, making it a hot collector's item. But there's a twist... would you be privy to it?\r\n

1.msg: #b(Tonero wears a sly grin as he whispers his secret into your ear.)#k\r\n

2.msg: To be sure, this will make the elder Eurenth change his tune. And with that, I shall bid you adieu.\r\n

0.msg: This... This is a limited-edition, hand-stamped Angelic Buster Figurine! You're giving it to me, just like that?!\r\n

1.msg: It wasn't easy to get my hands on this, old man. But it's yours... if you can tell me what I want to know about the city center.\r\n

yes.0: #b(Eurenth whips out some papers and starts jotting down notes like a madman. Give him a moment to finish.)#k\r\n

default.0: It's almost impossible to get this Angelic Buster Figurine...

npc.0: You haven't brought him the gift yet? Why do you dally?\r\n
